title: The standalone /mcp runs in the workspace's whole services, as the product server's
request: also make sure all agentic system that we have design in the dclab r and d project and product work behind the chat (part of the Claude Code / Codex parity goal)
plan: Map every agent and service and what reaches /mcp (an exploration)
Make the standalone /mcp record and cap as the product server's

decisions.decision: The standalone server is the product server's app (create_app), not a second set of services
decisions.why: the Home agent's build and other routes exist only in the app; one implementation of every check, request id, visit and start-up refusal

decisions.decision: --home is the workspace folder, default DCLAB_AGENT_HOME, .env read first
decisions.why: the product server and the worker choose it so; a scratch run must never write into the owner's workspace and its training store

change: mcp_server.standalone_app(workspace) = create_app(workspace) after reading .env; main takes the workspace; consent read fresh in this second process.

findings.defect: the standalone /mcp recorded no event, decision, usage or kept call
findings.scenario: DCLab Code's chat called create_project and set_solution: nothing reached the experience log, the ledger or mcp/calls.jsonl

findings.defect: the Home agent could not build from DCLab Code's chat
findings.scenario: home 'build it' through the standalone server
findings.cause: build_from_chat exists only inside the product app's routes
findings.fix: the standalone server is the product app

findings.scenario: a scratch run wrote experience, ledger and usage into the owner's workspace
findings.cause: --home defaulted to default_home()/projects before .env was read
findings.fix: --home is the workspace, chosen as the server does, after .env

findings.defect: no sign-in check in the standalone server
findings.scenario: DCLAB_AUTH=password: any local process wrote through :8777 without a token
findings.fix: create_app's start-up checks and token on /mcp

findings.defect: the usage log and the cap were not tested
findings.cause: the test checked the wiring only
findings.fix: a scripted request in the usage log, the next refused over the workspace's cap

findings.defect: events had no request id, trace or visit
findings.scenario: grouping a standalone call's events by request

findings.defect: a consent switched in another process was read 10 s late
findings.scenario: the owner turns a project's consent off on :8765

measurements.name: MCP tests
measurements.gate: every test passes on files and PostgreSQL; the new test fails without the change
measurements.result: test_mcp 6 passed on files, 5 of 5 on PostgreSQL before the last test was added; the old standalone_app fails the new test

outcome: A chat's call through DCLab's standalone /mcp is recorded and capped as one through the product server.
lessons: Reuse the app, not its parts: the routes held logic (a build) a second set of services did not have
A default workspace is a training-data decision: it must follow the same settings as the server's
risks: two processes on one file workspace race on jobs and draft turns
